item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00340","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C20","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.76,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a material proclamation template: it moves from the historical achievement being commemorated, through planned centennial celebrations and their broader significance, to a congressional resolution calling for presidential recognition, followed by an operative centennial observance. The child adapts that sequence from Oregon statehood to Italian unification and changes the operative act from calling for observance to extending national greetings. C20 is a close but shorter centennial precedent, while C11 shares the centennial setting and inspirational treatment but has a less similar congressional and operative structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the centennial of the unification of Italy... commemorates a great event in the history of nations","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the year 1959 will mark the one hundredth anniversary of statehood for Oregon... and the Legislative Assembly of that State has provided for a Centennial Celebration","explanation":"Both introduce a centennial by identifying the foundational historical event and its organized commemoration."},{"child_excerpt":"there will be many celebrations in Italy, in the United States, and in many other countries","parent_excerpt":"this Celebration... will bring to the attention of the Nation and the world","explanation":"Both frame the centennial as a celebration extending beyond the immediate jurisdiction and carrying international significance."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas it is the sense of the Congress, expressed by House Concurrent Resolution 225... that the President extend official greetings","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the Congress of the United States, by a joint resolution... authorized the President... to issue a proclamation calling upon the people to commemorate","explanation":"The penultimate recital in each invokes a specific congressional resolution directing or encouraging presidential recognition of the centennial."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby extend greetings and felicitations... in recognition of the progress and achievements of the Italian people during the past century","parent_excerpt":"do hereby call upon the American people to observe the one hundredth anniversary... by appropriate activities and ceremonies","explanation":"Each operative clause implements the congressional request by formally recognizing the centennial, with the child adapting the requested action to diplomatic greetings."}]}
